situations.title: 신경학적 사정
situations.tagline: He doesn't seem to squeeze my hand as well as he did an hour ago — is that bad?
situations.brief: GCS와 동공 추세를 통해 신경학적 상태를 체계적으로 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm checking how alert he is, his pupils, and his hand strength.
Any change from an hour ago is important, so thank you for noticing.
I'll compare this with his earlier exam and update the team.

situations.title: 두부 거상·중립 체위
situations.tagline: Why do you keep his head propped up and so perfectly straight like that?
situations.brief: 정맥 배출을 촉진하도록 두부 거상과 중립 체위를 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: Keeping his head up and midline helps blood drain from his brain.
This position helps lower the pressure inside his head.
We avoid turning his neck to keep that drainage open.
goals: 두부 거상과 중립 체위를 정확히 유지한다

situations.title: EVD 시스템·영점 이해
situations.tagline: What is that tube draining from his head, and why is it hung at that exact height?
situations.brief: EVD 시스템의 배액 높이와 영점의 원리를 이해하고 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: This drain removes extra fluid to control the pressure in his brain.
Its height is set to a reference point at his ear to drain correctly.
I keep it leveled precisely so it drains the right amount.
goals: EVD 배액 높이와 영점의 원리를 이해한다

situations.title: ICP·CPP 모니터 판독
situations.tagline: Those numbers on the monitor keep changing — what are they supposed to be?
situations.brief: ICP와 CPP 모니터의 목표 범위를 판독하고 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: One number is the pressure in his brain, the other is his brain's blood flow.
We aim to keep the pressure low and the flow adequate.
I watch these closely and act if they move out of range.

situations.title: 진정·통증 관리 협조
situations.tagline: He winces when you move him — can't you keep him more comfortable?
situations.brief: ICP 상승을 예방하도록 진정과 통증 관리에 협조하세요.
keyPhrases: Keeping him calm and pain-free helps lower his brain pressure.
We give sedation and pain medicine to prevent spikes.
I'll assess his comfort regularly and adjust as needed.
goals: 진정과 통증 관리로 ICP 상승을 예방한다

situations.title: 자극 최소화
situations.tagline: Should we keep the lights and noise down so we don't upset him?
situations.brief: ICP를 유발하는 자극을 파악하고 환경 자극을 최소화하세요.
keyPhrases: Yes, a quiet, dim room helps keep his brain pressure down.
We cluster his care so he can rest between activities.
Soft voices and gentle touch are best right now.
goals: 환경 자극을 최소화하고 케어를 묶어서 시행한다

situations.title: ICP 상승 단계별 중재
situations.tagline: His ICP just climbed into the twenties — what's our first move here?
situations.brief: 체위와 진정, 삼투요법 순으로 ICP 상승에 단계별로 중재하세요.
keyPhrases: First let's optimize his position and deepen sedation.
If it stays high, we'll move to osmotic therapy.
I'll drain the EVD per parameters and notify the team.
goals: ICP 상승에 체위와 진정부터 단계별로 중재한다

situations.title: 삼투요법 투여
situations.tagline: Are we giving mannitol or hypertonic saline, and what should I watch after?
situations.brief: 만니톨이나 고장성 용액을 용량에 맞춰 투여하고 반응을 모니터하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll give the ordered dose and watch the ICP response.
Monitor his sodium, osmolality, and urine output closely.
Check blood pressure so he doesn't get too dry.

situations.title: EVD 배액량·파형 관리
situations.tagline: The drainage looks lower this hour and the waveform seems off — can you check?
situations.brief: EVD 배액량과 파형을 확인하고 배액을 적절히 조절하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm the drain is level and the tubing isn't kinked.
A dampened waveform can mean it's not draining well.
I'll check for fluctuation and notify neurosurgery if it's blocked.

situations.title: CPP 목표 승압·수액 유지
situations.tagline: His CPP is drifting below target — do we bump the pressor or give fluid?
situations.brief: CPP 목표를 위해 승압과 수액으로 관류 균형을 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: To raise his CPP we support his blood pressure with a pressor.
Let's ensure he's adequately filled before increasing the drip.
I'll balance flow to his brain without overloading him.
goals: CPP 목표를 위해 승압과 수액을 조정한다

situations.title: 과호흡 일시 사용 이해
situations.tagline: Are we bumping up his ventilator rate to blow off CO2 for a bit?
situations.brief: 과호흡의 일시적 사용과 CO2 관련 주의점을 이해하세요.
keyPhrases: Brief hyperventilation lowers CO2 to quickly reduce brain pressure.
It's only a temporary bridge because too much can cut blood flow.
We'll monitor his CO2 and return to normal soon.

situations.title: 발작 예방·감시
situations.tagline: Is he on something to prevent seizures, and how would we even know if he had one?
situations.brief: 항경련제와 EEG를 통해 발작을 예방하고 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: He's on a seizure-prevention medication given his brain injury.
Continuous EEG helps us catch seizures we can't see.
I'll watch for subtle signs like twitching or eye deviation.

situations.title: 나트륨 목표 관리
situations.tagline: We're keeping his sodium on the high side — what's the target and how do we hold it?
situations.brief: 고나트륨 요법으로 나트륨 목표를 안전하게 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: We keep his sodium elevated to help pull fluid from his brain.
I'll check levels frequently and titrate the hypertonic fluid.
We avoid big swings to protect his brain.

situations.title: 이송·검사 중 ICP 관리
situations.tagline: He's due for a CT — how do we keep his brain pressure safe during the move?
situations.brief: CT 이동 등 이송 중에도 ICP를 안전하게 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll keep his head up and sedation ready during transport.
I'll clamp or manage the EVD per protocol before we move.
Let's have osmotic therapy on hand in case it spikes.
goals: 이송 중 두부 거상과 진정을 유지한다
ICP 상승에 대비해 EVD와 약물을 준비한다

situations.title: 진정 중단과 신경검사 균형
situations.tagline: Can we lighten his sedation for a neuro check without his pressure spiking?
situations.brief: 각성 창을 위해 진정 중단과 신경검사의 균형을 맞추세요.
keyPhrases: We'll briefly lighten sedation to assess his neuro status.
I'll watch his ICP closely and re-sedate if it climbs.
We time the wake-up window when he's most stable.
goals: 각성 창을 위해 진정을 안전하게 조절한다
신경검사와 ICP 안정 사이의 균형을 맞춘다

situations.title: 뇌탈출 임박 위기
situations.tagline: One of his pupils just blew and he's posturing — we have to move now!
situations.brief: 동공산대와 함께 뇌탈출 임박에 응급 삼투와 과호흡, 수술 연계로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: A blown pupil means herniation — give hypertonic and hyperventilate now.
Call neurosurgery stat and prep for the OR.
I'm draining the EVD and elevating his head immediately.
goals: 응급 삼투와 과호흡, 수술 연계를 신속히 시행한다

situations.title: EVD 막힘·과배액 위기
situations.tagline: The drain suddenly stopped and now his ICP is shooting up — what do we do?
situations.brief: EVD 막힘과 과배액 문제를 해결하고 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Check the level, stopcock, and tubing — it may be blocked.
Don't flush without an order; call neurosurgery now.
If it over-drained, we reposition and reassess immediately.

situations.title: ICP 급상승 불응 위기
situations.tagline: We've tried everything and his ICP won't come down — is surgery the next step?
situations.brief: 불응성 ICP 급상승에 다단계 중재와 감압수술 소통으로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: We've maxed medical therapy, so decompressive surgery is on the table.
Let's confirm sedation, osmotic doses, and CO2 are optimized.
I'll get neurosurgery to the bedside now.

situations.title: 급성 뇌출혈 확대 악화
situations.tagline: His exam looked stable and now he's crashing — could the bleed be getting bigger?
situations.brief: 급성 뇌출혈 확대에 따른 악화를 인지하고 응급 영상과 수술을 연계하세요.
keyPhrases: This rapid decline could mean the bleed is expanding.
Let's get a stat CT and call neurosurgery.
I'm reversing any anticoagulation per protocol now.

situations.title: 요붕증·SIADH 급변 관리
situations.tagline: His urine output and sodium just swung wildly — is this DI or SIADH?
situations.brief: 요붕증과 SIADH에 따른 나트륨 급변을 감별하고 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Massive dilute urine with rising sodium points to DI.
Low sodium with concentrated urine suggests SIADH.
Let's match fluids to the pattern and recheck sodium closely.

situations.title: 뇌사 진행 인지·검사 연계
situations.tagline: I need to understand — are you telling me his brain may be gone for good?
situations.brief: 뇌사 진행을 인지하고 검사 연계와 장기기증 소통을 신중히 진행하세요.
keyPhrases: His exam shows very concerning signs, and we're doing formal testing.
The team will explain each step and what the results mean.
We'll support you and discuss his wishes when you're ready.
goals: 뇌사 진행 소견을 인지하고 검사를 연계한다
